title: Chapter 771 The Pearl; Its Location!
content:
Chapter 771 The Pearl; Its Location!

Chapter 771 The Pearl; Its Location!

When Kaien said this, his eyes were fixed on Lin Fan. There was a hint of worry and anxiety in his tone.

That was because he didn't know what kind of relationship Lin Fan had with the Sea Sky Pavilion.

He wondered why Lin Fan had come to the Sea Sky Pavilion.

Lin Fan knew what Kaien was thinking with a single glance.

"Don't worry. I have nothing to do with the Sea Sky Pavilion. It's just that there's something I want inside."

"As for their pavilion master, there's no need to worry. He relied on the formation of the Sea Sky Pavilion to obtain some power that doesn't belong to him."

As he spoke, Lin Fan had already arrived in front of the doors of the Sea Sky Pavilion.

" Who's there?!" The two disciples at the door shouted.

Lin Fan's reply was to casually point.

"Plop!"

"Plop!"

The two disciples fell to the ground, unable to get up.

The commotion here quickly attracted the attention of the others in the Sea Sky Pavilion.

A powerful aura gushed out from within.

A large group of people shot out like sharp arrows.

"Kane!"

"It's Kane!"

"Kill them!"

" You actually dare to come to my Sea Sky Pavilion? How audacious!"

"Kill him!"

Shouts of battle rose and fell.

Initially, Lin Fan only wanted to take the pearl and didn't want to kill anyone.

However, at this moment, facing the shouts of others, he could no longer hold back.

Even though the other party's main target was not him.

"Whoosh!"

He saw…

Lin Fan waved his hand casually, and the shouts and shouts stopped abruptly.

They fell to the ground like big radishes. There was no vitality left!

At this moment, a loud voice came from the Sea Sky Pavilion.

"Bastard!"

Then, the huge Sea Sky Pavilion seemed to have transformed into a primordial beast, baring its fangs and brandishing its claws.

Then, he charged towards Lin Fan.

In response, Lin Fan pointed out casually.

A terrifying energy pillar poured down.

"Whoosh!"

Instantly, the entire world turned white.

Everyone lost their sight.

After an unknown period of time, the world returned to normal.

The next moment, Kaien, who was standing beside Lin Fan, opened his mouth wide.

He was completely stunned.

Because the huge Sea Sky Pavilion had already disappeared.

If not for the fact that the surrounding mountains were still there.

Kaien almost thought that he was no longer in the Sea Sky Pavilion.

So, Lin Fan had destroyed the Sea Sky Pavilion with just a wave of his hand?

In fact, it was just as Kane had expected.

Because Lin Fan didn't like trouble.

Now that he had become enemies with the Sea Sky Pavilion, he might as well settle it once and for all.

He didn't like the endless drama of beating up the younger one and bringing up the older one.

Lin Fan grabbed at the air and a fiery red pearl appeared in his hand.

He had obtained another one!

"I've got what I wanted, so I'll be leaving first," he said to Kane.

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan took a step forward and disappeared without a trace.

Kane was left in a daze.

There was only one thought in his mind. Who exactly was Lin Fan? What realm had his cultivation reached?

....

Lin Fan had done this casually. He didn't care about how Kaien would react after that.

He took a step forward and crossed space. A few days later, he returned to Earth.

Then, he entered a state of cultivation.

Lin Fan willed it and came to the River of Time.

He took a step forward and directly arrived on the Time Great Dao.

Walking on the path of time, he was surrounded by memories of the past that were like movies.

"Whoosh!"

At this moment, light swirled not far away and gradually condensed into a human figure.

The figure turned his body and looked over. Soon, he revealed a smile.

"Fellow Daoist Lin!"

This person was Tao Qian, whom he had met not long ago.

"Fellow Daoist Tao." Lin Fan replied.

Lin Fan had a pretty good impression of this Dao Friend Tao.

Last time, the other party had exchanged time comprehension with him without holding back, allowing him to have a certain improvement in the Great Dao of Time.

"Fellow Daoist Lin, I have some new insights this time…" Tao Qian said.

Lin Fan smiled," I have an idea too."

The two of them looked at each other and smiled. As they walked, they exchanged their understanding of time.

Unknowingly, the two of them walked further and further on the path of time, and their gains became richer and richer.

They only stopped when they reached 350,000 meters.

"See you next time, Fellow Daoist Lin," Tao Qian said with a smile.

"See you next time." Lin Fan said.

When Lin Fan retracted his consciousness, a crisp notification rang out in his mind.

[Ding! [Tao Qian's favorability towards you has increased to 6 stars.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he rubbed his chin.

Tao Qian was willing to give him a favorable impression of 6 stars.

....

In the blink of an eye, 50 years had passed.

With each passing day, Lin Fan's aura grew stronger.

However, he did not show any signs of breaking through.

On this day, a voice rang out in Lin Fan's mind.

"Master."

Lin Fan's mind moved slightly and he knew that this voice came from Ma Zheng.

Thus, he used soul communication with Ma Zheng.

"Greetings, Master!" Ma Zheng said respectfully.

"What's the matter?" Lin Fan asked.

"Master asked me to find the orb. I got some information." Ma Zheng said.

"Oh?" Lin Fan's expression changed slightly.

" About 300 years ago, someone from the Ocean Forest Star in the Western Region of the Divine Astral Universe saw the orb," Ma Zheng said hurriedly." But, not long ago, I went to the Ocean Hidden Star and didn't find the orb…"

" I'm sorry, Master." He knelt on the ground again." I didn't do my job well. Please punish me, Master."

Lin Fan smiled," You've already done well. Why should I punish you?" Not bad! You can continue to pay attention to the other orbs."

Master, you're already saying that you're not bad!

"Yes, Master!" Ma Zheng said excitedly.

After ending the soul connection, Lin Fan leaped out.

His target was the Divine Astral Universe.

A few days later, a green planet appeared in the sky.

This was the Ocean Forest Planet.

The size of this planet was about 10 times that of Earth. It was very huge.

Lin Fan couldn't help but think that if Earth was so big, there probably wouldn't be so many people traveling around the world in the past, right?

He shook his head slightly and threw this thought aside.

Then, it flashed across the entire Ocean Forest Planet.

After a while, Lin Fan stopped in his tracks.

That was because he had already explored the entire Ocean Forest Planet, but he did not find any traces of the orb.

However, this was also within his expectations.

Therefore, he did not show any displeasure.

After all, 300 years had passed since the news of the orb.

Since the Orb had not been discovered on Planet Hailin, there was no need to stay any longer.

Lin Fan took a step forward and flew towards a nearby planet.

Perhaps the orb was on a nearby planet?

In a short 10 days, Lin Fan had scouted the surrounding 100 planets, but he still found nothing.

Just as Lin Fan was about to give up, his expression changed slightly.

That was because he had suddenly discovered traces of the orb!
